name: Charcoal Burner
text: End of Turn: burn up to 6 of your gold above 5. The units behind this gain a twentieth of their stats per gold.
golden_text: End of Turn: burn up to 12 of your gold above 5. The units behind this gain a twentieth of their stats per gold.

source.note: Pass 3 neutrals, section 8; owner-approved Click homecomings and Charcoal body-only readings in DECISIONS.

details: Reads each recipient's own base plus permanent body stats; excludes Rings, auras and standing tribe bonuses. Shares round down. Golden increases only the gold burned.
golden_details: Reads each recipient's own base plus permanent body stats; excludes Rings, auras and standing tribe bonuses. Shares round down. Golden increases only the gold burned.
